alt.en: A large satellite sits between a teal sphere on the left and a gray server on the right. Dotted gray lines connect the satellite to both objects.
alt.zh: 一颗大型卫星位于画面中央，左侧是青绿色球体，右侧是灰色服务器；灰色点线将卫星与两者相连。

caption.en: Illustration: A satellite represents a probe inferring an agent’s policy state from execution on a shared GPU host; the scene does not depict a tested deployment.
caption.zh: 示意图：卫星代表探针，通过共享 GPU 主机的执行情况推断智能体的策略状态；画面并非经过测试的实际部署。
